id.description: File link id — integer (numeric string ok) (operations: delete, get, download, open, get_project_storage, open_project_storage, delete_storage, get_storage, update_storage, get_storage_files, prepare_storage_file_upload, create_storage_folder, create_storage_oauth_credentials, open_storage)

location.description: Boolean flag indicating, if the file should be opened directly or rather the directory location. (operations: open)

filters.description:
JSON specifying filter conditions.
Accepts the same format as returned by the [queries](https://www.openproject.org/docs/api/endpoints/queries/)
endpoint. Currently supported filters are:

- project_id
- storage_id
- storage_url (operations: list_project_storages)

name.description: Storage name, if not provided, falls back to a default. (operations: create_storage, update_storage, create_storage_folder)

storageAudience.description:
The audience that the storage expects in tokens for requests to it,
usually the storage's client ID at the identity provider.

This is only required for authentication through single-sign-on and so far
only supported for provider type Nextcloud. (operations: create_storage, update_storage)

tokenExchangeScope.description:
The scope that will be requested when requesting a token for the storage through token exchange. Has no effect if no
token exchange is performed.

This is only required for authentication through single-sign-on and so far only supported for provider type Nextcloud. (operations: create_storage, update_storage)

applicationPassword.description:
The application password to use for the Nextcloud storage. Ignored if the provider type is not Nextcloud.

If a string is provided, the password is set and automatic management is enabled for the storage.
If null is provided, the password is unset and automatic management is disabled for the storage. (operations: create_storage, update_storage)

forbiddenFileNameCharacters.description:
A string with all the characters forbidden to be used for file and folder names in the storage. Used by OpenProject to avoid
creating files with unsupported names (e.g. when creating project folders).

Only supported for provider type Nextcloud so far. (operations: create_storage, update_storage)

projectId.description: The project identifier, from where a user starts uploading a file. — integer >= 1 (numeric string ok) (operations: prepare_storage_file_upload)

parentId.description: Unique identifier of the parent folder in which the new folder should be created in (operations: create_storage_folder)

confirmed.description: Optional. Two-Phase write confirm: set confirmed=true (or ja/yes/1) to execute POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE. Without it, mutating calls return a confirmation ask.
